title: 『全７都市巡る台湾縦断』台北(台湾)の旅行記・ブログ by edih7さんciteフォートラベル
description:
Taichung’s Rainbow Village

A group of visitors strolls along a narrow lane in Taichung’s Rainbow Village, marveling at the riot of color that envelops every surface. The humble row of single-story houses has been transformed into a vibrant open-air gallery by an elderly local artist, whose whimsical designs feature flowers, animals, and smiling faces in bold primary hues. Under a bright midday sun, the painted walls and ground patterns create a cheerful, immersive environment that draws photographers and art lovers alike.

This stop was part of a larger seven-city Taiwan tour, which included Taipei’s iconic 101 observatory, the lantern-lit sky of Shifen, and the nostalgic alleys of Jiufen. Travelers rated the overall experience highly for sightseeing and transportation, noting the ease of bus and high-speed rail connections. The Rainbow Village stands out as a testament to individual creativity, turning a once-forgotten military settlement into one of central Taiwan’s most Instagrammed landmarks.
